DESCRIPTION: The Ready-to-Assay MRGPRD Receptor Frozen Cells are a simple, thaw-and-assay cell format for use in studying drug candidates (small molecules or biologics) targeting GPCRs. This assay assesses ligand (e.g. β-alanine) based activation of MRGPRD GPCR activity via detection of increasing levels of intracellular calcium. The included cells overexpress MRGPRD alongside endogenous high levels of a promiscuous G-protein, coupling the receptor to the calcium signaling pathway. Upon activation of MRGPRD , the resulting calcium activity can be fluorescently assayed. Ready-to-assay kits consist of two vials of the stably modified clonal cell line in a convenient thaw-and-use format.

This assay assesses ligand (e.g. bombesin) based activation of BRS3 GPCR activity via detection of increasing levels of intracellular calcium. Ready-to-assay kits consist of two vials of the stably modified clonal cell line in a convenient thaw-and-use format.

DESCRIPTION: For cryopreservation of hematopoieticstem cells, dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) has generally been used as a cryoprotectant. In the case ofcryopreservation with DMSO alone, it was common to be stored in liquid nitrogen (-196°C) after frozen by the stepwisefreezing method with a program freezer. However, from the early 1980's, simple cell freezing methods that do not use a program freezer have been studiedusing DMSO and hydroxyethyl starch (HES) for hematopoietic stem cells in bone marrow. In Japan, studies on application of simple cell freezing method using DMSO and HES toperipheral blood stem cells have beenadvanced, and the optimum concentrations of HES and DMSO in the simple cell freezing method were decided 6% HES, 5% DMSO. This simple cell freezing method enabled stable cryopreservation for a short period of time (6 months to 1 year and a half) using a -80°C freezer without stepwise freezing method. PRODUCT_VARIANT_NAME: Direct Thermal Cryo Label, 38x13mm for Cryogenic Vials, 750 per Roll, 1/Roll, Yellow
PRODUCT_NAME: Direct Thermal Cryo Label, 38x13mm for Cryogenic Vials, 750 per Roll, 1/Roll, Yellow
DESCRIPTION: Cryogenic, waterproof labels suitable for cryovials, microtubes, microplates, glass tubes, freezer boxes, plastic bags and other types of containers for storage in liquid and vapor phase nitrogen (-196°C), laboratory freezers (-120ºC, -80ºC, -20ºC), and transportation on dry ice. Comprised of a thin thermoplastic film and a special cryogenic adhesive, these durable labels do not become brittle or crack, and have a strong affinity for polyethylene, polypropylene and other plastic and glass surfaces. They also resist smearing without additional lamination or wrap-around. Available in white or a variety of colors upon request. Supplied in roll format and are compatible with all major brands of direct thermal barcode printers, such as Zebra, Intermec, Citizen, Cognitive, Printronix, Datamax O`Neil, SATO and others. They can also be written on with our cryo- or permanent markers. The labels are resistant to standard ethylene oxide gas sterilization, consisting of a 60-minute exposure to 759mg/L of ethylene oxide gas, at 55oC, and 40-80% relative humidity, followed by a two-hour aeration cycle.

PRODUCT_NAME: Chemical Resistant Dymo Compatible Cryogenic Labels - 0.5" X 1"
DESCRIPTION:
DYMO-compatible chemical and ultra-low temperature resistant labels. Ideal for the identification and permanent storage of vials, tubes, and other containers in liquid nitrogen (-196°C/-321°F), laboratory freezers (-80°C/-112°F), and dry ice transportation. Coated with a strong permanent adhesive, these direct thermal labels withstand multiple freeze-thaw cycles and can be immersed in liquid nitrogen directly after application, requiring zero cure time. These cryo labels can also withstand direct exposure to harsh chemicals, solvents, and detergents, such as alcohols, toluene, acetone, and xylene, as well as rubbing with surface sanitizing wipes. Resistant to short-term immersion (up to 3 minutes) in alcohols and xylene.
